f20003.title: Treatment/medication code
f20003.$comment: Source coding: encoding 4. Up to 48 entries, stored as an array in one field (D021). The source lists 6745 codes, over the 300-code limit, so membership of the list is not checked: the schema asserts only an integer between the lowest (1185) and highest (2038507816) listed code (D039).
